assumptions.instanceType: m7i-flex.large (free-tier eligible; t3a.large is rejected by this account)
assumptions.taxPercentMeaning: Conservative 20% reserve for tax and fees, not this account's actual rate
assumptions.hourlyVsMonthly: ec2Hour, ipv4Hour and outboundGb scale with runtimeHoursPerMonth; gp3GbMonth, snapshotGbMonth, ecrGbMonth, s3GbMonth and logStorageGbMonth are monthly charges that accrue even while the instance is stopped

limitations: A pre-deployment estimate from public rates, not a bill.
Cost Explorer can read 0.00 USD while billing lags up to 24 hours and credits mask usage; neither means the resources are free.
Budgets are delayed alerts, not a hard cap.
DeepSeek API usage is billed separately and is not part of this figure.
An always-on instance exceeds the 50 USD ceiling, which is why the session deadline exists.
